gaps.why: No IQM document fetched places the cloud-accessible Garnet or Emerald QPUs at a named facility (IQM mentions a quantum data centre in Munich but does not tie these machines to it).
gaps.would_need: IQM statement naming the facility hosting Garnet/Emerald.

gaps.why: www.sec.gov/Archives refused the declared User-Agent (HTTP 403 'Undeclared Automated Tool'); IR site investors.iqm.tech failed (HTTP/2 error). System counts, roadmap and risk factors from the prospectus could not be quoted.
gaps.would_need: IR-hosted copy of the F-1/424B3 prospectus.

gaps.why: IQM's Nov 2024 roadmap release targets logical error rates 'below 10^-7'; the current roadmap page says the roadmap 'targets logical error rates reaching 10⁻⁹'. Neither text gives a date for the error-rate goal, so the change was not recorded as a dated target revision.
gaps.would_need: Dated roadmap document stating the error-rate target with a year.

gaps.why: IQM's 99.51% median CZ fidelity release refers to 'the 20-qubit quantum computer' without naming Garnet, so it was recorded as a milestone, not as a Garnet metric.
gaps.would_need: IQM document tying benchmark numbers to Garnet by name.

gaps.why: OQC's roadmap page is undated (timeline images uploaded April 2026); no OQC-hosted June 2025 roadmap release was found and the Wayback Machine was offline, so the original stated_on date and any changes between versions could not be verified. Targets use the access date as stated_on.
gaps.would_need: OQC's June 2025 roadmap press release or an archived copy of oqc.tech/roadmap from 2025.

gaps.why: OQC states Toshiko is deployed in datacentres in the UK, Japan and Spain, but no fetched document names which facility hosts a Toshiko system today. Equinix TY11 (Tokyo, 2023 plan) and Cyxtera LHR3 (Reading, 2022 plan) are recorded as announced sites only; CESGA (Galicia) installation of a 32-qubit OQC machine was announced in 2023 without a confirming release.
gaps.would_need: OQC or host releases confirming Toshiko is operational at a named facility.

gaps.why: No OQC primary document fetched states two-qubit fidelity for Toshiko with a definition.
gaps.would_need: OQC datasheet or Braket/OQC Cloud device page with a stated median/mean definition.

gaps.why: The Sept 2025 release says GENESIS is 'installed' at JFK10, while the devices page says GENESIS 'will feature' 16 DDQs and the roadmap says commercially available from 2026. Recorded as announced.
gaps.would_need: OQC statement that GENESIS is operational / available to customers.
